vec2slug-v1-openai-small.training_details: BPE vocabulary (5,000 subwords) with `-` as a special token. Trained for 30 epochs with label smoothing (0.1) and position-aware EOS loss weighting. Best checkpoint at step 53,430.
vec2slug-v1-openai-small.variant_note: This is the **smaller** of two variants. It is recommended for most deployments: the larger model adds only +0.008 Token F1 at 2x the inference cost.

vec2slug-v1-openai-large.training_details: BPE vocabulary (5,000 subwords) with `-` as a special token. Trained for 36 epochs with label smoothing (0.1) and position-aware EOS loss weighting. Best checkpoint at step 70,560.
vec2slug-v1-openai-large.variant_note: This is the **larger** of two variants. It achieves the best Token F1 but at 2x the inference cost of the smaller model.
